name: PAR LED RGB 3ch
note: The Brisas BX-940 on the bar are 5 ch (R,G,B,W,A) but are patched every 3: the W/A of each one lands on the R/G/B of its neighbour. While the rig stays like this, the unit IS a 3 ch unit. A 4 ch RGBW profile at spacing 3 raises PatchError, and that is the right behaviour.
